avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces flecainide levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases flecainide concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; advise against high-dose grapefruit consumption

avoid_supplements.name: Alkaline-forming supplements (sodium bicarbonate, potassium citrate)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased urinary pH decreases renal elimination, elevating flecainide levels and arrhythmia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid alkalinizing supplements; monitor urine pH if used; coordinate with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive cardiac effects; high doses could theoretically potentiate arrhythmia risk
caution_supplements.action: Use standard supplemental doses; monitor for palpitations or cardiac symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Licorice
caution_supplements.mechanism: May cause hypokalemia and sodium retention, increasing arrhythmia susceptibility
caution_supplements.action: Limit licorice intake; maintain electrolyte monitoring

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases flecainide bioavailability and plasma concentration
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance recommended; switch to alternative juices (orange, apple)

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium may contribute to fluid retention and electrolyte imbalance, affecting cardiac function
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake; follow heart-healthy dietary guidelines

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may increase sympathetic activity and trigger arrhythmias in susceptible patients
caution_foods.action: Limit coffee, tea, energy drinks; individual tolerance varies

monitoring_notes: Monitor flecainide plasma levels (therapeutic range 0.2-1.0 mcg/mL) when CYP2D6/3A4 interactions are suspected. Regular assessment of renal function and serum electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium) is essential, as flecainide has narrow therapeutic index and renal clearance is significant.
